name: Spirit Cyclone OLD
description: A cyclone of angry spirits surges around the area.
disable: DC 30 Occultism (trained) or DC 30 Religion (trained) to weaken the haunt; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt
reset: The spirit cyclone disperses after 1 minute and resets after 1 day.
routine: (3 actions) The spirit cyclone uses 3 actions to move, traveling up to 30 feet with each action and dealing (2d10+13) Void Damage damage to each creature in its path (Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature needs to attempt only one save during the cyclone's movement, even if the cyclone moves over its space more than once. On a critical failure, a creature is swept up into the cyclone, becoming Grabbed (Escape dc=32). A creature grabbed by the cyclone moves along with the cyclone and takes (1d10+6) Void Damage damage at their beginning of its turn, and it must attempt a Reflex save against the cyclone on the cyclone's turn, no matter where the cyclone moves. A creature that successfully Escapes from the cyclone falls from a height of 1d12 x 5 feet.

generalAbilities.name: Gather Spirit
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures enter the area

Effect A spiraling column of spirits gather, becoming a whirling cyclone of souls 10 feet wide and 60 feet tall. The haunt then rolls initiative.
